events.headline: The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Sunday, Nov. 15 to the morning of Tuesday, Nov. 24. A signed detour will be in place.

From 9 p.m. and 5 a.m. nightly, Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Saturday morning, Nov. 21, the westbound I-90 on-ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Saturday morning, Nov. 21, the eastbound I-90 off-ramp to 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
The westbound Winchester rest area on I90 at milepost 161.83 will be closed for maintenance until further notice.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting
the night of Sunday, Nov. 15 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 20. A signed detour will be in place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Saturday morning, Nov. 21, the 148th Avenue Southeast on-ramp to westbound I-90 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

Westbound Interstate 90 is open to two lanes at milepost 174, at Hansen Road just west of Moses Lake, while eastbound I-90 is open to one lane from Aug. 24 until January of 2027. Eastbound travelers heading north or south of Hansen Road must use Exit 169 at Hiawatha Road. Westbound travelers heading north may use exit 174. Travelers heading south must use exit 169 and follow the South Frontage Road detour.
